sourceAttempts.family: South Dakota Game Fish and Parks
sourceAttempts.method: current paddling page and Jay Heath PDF extraction
sourceAttempts.result: Confirmed the official trail, access-site chain, and the 8.8-mile Lien Park to Big Sioux Recreation Area North segment; the PDF did not provide endpoint coordinates or numeric thresholds.
USGS 06482020 returned same-day Big Sioux discharge and stage (276 cfs / 5.67 ft at 06:30 CDT); USGS 06467500 returned same-day Missouri River stage (10.61 ft) but no discharge.

sourceAttempts.method: park directory page and published map coordinate
sourceAttempts.result: Confirmed Lien Park at 43.5687088,-96.7093183, but the city lists recreation-trail access rather than a canoe/kayak launch.

sourceAttempts.method: route-specific paddling map and trip report review
sourceAttempts.result: Found a 250 cfs minimum tied to the North Cliff gauge and Lien Park route context, but also found that Lien is an undeveloped, steep, muddy, difficult put-in rather than a normal public launch.
Narrowed the broad MNRR lead to Myron Grove RM 787.1 to Clay County RM 781.0, a 6.1-mile official access-to-access segment with manager, facility, and hazard context.

sourceAttempts.method: MNRR river-access inventory and waypoint extraction
sourceAttempts.result: Confirmed public access and converted NPS waypoints for Myron Grove and Clay County to decimal coordinates.
Confirmed official Gavins Point reach bounds of 16,000 cfs low and over 40,000 cfs very high, plus release-driven current, wind, snags, shifting-channel, private-bank, and cold-water hazards.

sourceAttempts.method: Gavins Point dam operations page review
sourceAttempts.result: Confirmed that the reach is controlled by Gavins Point releases; PaddleToday has no adapter for the required USACE release source.

factsChanged: Jay Heath gauge freshness restored with same-day USGS 06482020 observations.
Jay Heath threshold support strengthened to a conservative community 250 cfs minimum.
Jay Heath status changed to needs_manual_coordinates/access-legitimacy review because Lien Park is not manager-designated as a paddle launch and the take-out launch coordinate remains unresolved.
MNRR lead narrowed to Myron Grove to Clay County Park with official 6.1-mile route shape and endpoint coordinates.
MNRR threshold support strengthened to official two-sided reach guidance.
MNRR status changed to no_live_gauge with a precise USACE Gavins Point release-adapter requirement.
claims.notes: No route was added. The pilot materially advanced two South Dakota candidates and converted vague research blockers into one endpoint-legitimacy task and one concrete engineering-adapter task without weakening product gates.
